description: Defines the interface and class for a video decoder using libde265, including methods for initialization, decoding, and managing decode targets.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a video decoder using libde265, supporting initialization, decoding, and output management.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for VideoDecoder, initializes with codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callbacks.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames (8).

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current decode target for rendering.
